description:
Refactor the SocialApp layout to use dimension resources and implement responsive design for tablets.

1. Analyze 'app/src/main/res/layout/activity_profile.xml' which currently uses hardcoded values (e.g., '16dp', '24dp', '80dp', '14sp').
2. Extract these values into 'app/src/main/res/values/dimens.xml' with semantic names (e.g., spacing_medium, avatar_size).
3. Create a new resource directory 'values-sw600dp' and a 'dimens.xml' file within it.
4. In the tablet ('sw600dp') dimensions, override the values to be larger (e.g., 16dp->32dp, 80dp->120dp) to better fit larger screens.
5. Update the layout file to reference these dimensions (@dimen/...) instead of hardcoded values.
6. Verify the project builds successfully.
